top_categories.workout_context: 56ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At mile 60 of 130, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Sado Long Ride 210's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
At Sado Long Ride 210, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Sado Long Ride 210. Train it until it feels boring.
7,277ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.

Road-specific control matters at Sado Long Ride 210. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 130 miles.
7,277ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 7,277ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 130 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
130 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Sado Long Ride 210’s 130 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Durability, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 130 miles of mixed terrain in Sado Island, Niigata Prefecture, Japan.
